rows.label: qst703102_msg0001
rows.name:
Please collect Apple Lamps and
Steel Lamiboard for me, mo.

rows.label: qst703102_msg0002
rows.name:
You should be able to get both by
tinkering with machines lying
around Gula, mo.

rows.label: qst703102_msg0003
rows.name:
Then I'll make a Dodon-style Silver
Cylinder and get that treasure
in style, mo!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0101
rows.name:
While I was salvaging, an Unin
almost ate me, mo!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0102
rows.name:
I ran away as fast as I could, but
the Urchon followed me all the way
to the surface, mo!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0103
rows.name: Now I need you to drive it off, mo!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0201
rows.name:
Please open the treasure chest Dodon
brought up from the Cloud Sea, mo.

rows.label: qst703102_msg0202
rows.name:
...It's not like I'm scared a monster
might jump out, mo.

rows.label: qst703102_msg0203
rows.name:
I want the people who've helped me
to have the thrill of opening it,
mo.

rows.label: qst703102_msg0301
rows.name:
At last! I got the Gravity
Clutch, mo!!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0302
rows.name:
Now I'll take this to my partner...
finish that thing...

rows.label: qst703102_msg0303
rows.name:
If I can get lots of that...
I'll live it up, mo!!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0304
rows.name:
Well then, Dodon is going back to
Iira, mo. Thank you, mo!!

rows.label: qst703102_msg0306
rows.name:
Dodon will leave the collectibles
Dodon gathered here as your reward,
mo. Put them to good use, mo.
